title: Unified quality scorer suite for FP8/INT8 calibration and validation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a unified, extensible scoring suite that computes and aggregates task-appropriate quality metrics for quantized model profiles (FP8 and INT8). The suite will power calibration validation, automated quality gates in CI, and the runtime QA dashboard. It must support general-purpose metrics (perplexity), benchmark suites (MMLU-style accuracy/zero-shot/few-shot), text-generation overlap metrics (ROUGE, BLEU), and pluggable task-specific scorers (QA exact-match/F1, summarization ROUGE-L, translation BLEU, classification accuracy). Scoring must expose per-profile and per-dataset breakdowns, confidence intervals, and statistical significance tests for regression detection. Outputs are CSV/Parquet for downstream dashboards, JSON summaries for CI, and a small webview for quick diffs.
acceptance_criteria: Implement perplexity computation compatible with FP8/INT8 output distributions and support both token-level and sequence-level reporting
Integrate MMLU-style harness that runs evaluation prompts in zero-/one-/few-shot modes and emits per-task accuracy with standard error
Add ROUGE and BLEU scorers with configurable tokenization and detokenization hooks to match model tokenizer behavior
Expose an API for registering task-specific scorers (function signature + metadata) and include examples for QA and summarization
Produce aggregated quality reports that include weighted score, sample counts, 95% confidence intervals, and A/B regression p-values
Hook scoring suite into calibration workflow so that calibration artifacts (scale/zero-point maps) are linked to evaluations in output metadata
CI gating: fail pipeline if any profile regresses beyond configured thresholds; provide JSON summary artifact for triage
Deliver initial dashboard CSV/Parquet outputs and a minimal web diff tool for reviewers to compare reference vs quantized profile outputs
notes: Prior work to consult: ENG-4219 quant profiles calibration validation, ENG-6241 scorer bridge. Keep scoring implementation language-agnostic but provide a Python reference harness that can be called from CI. Avoid copying legacy evaluation code; prefer small, well-documented primitives. Plan for eventual export to the Console's observability pipelines (traces/metrics).
test_plan: 1) Unit tests for each scorer using controlled synthetic outputs (edge-cases: repeated tokens, truncated sequences). 2) Integration tests that run the full suite on a small calibration set and assert metrics within expected ranges. 3) Statistical regression tests that run Monte Carlo resampling to validate confidence interval calculations. CI must produce a JSON summary artifact and fail on configured regression thresholds.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Merge Python reference harness and add to quantization CI job (smoke). Phase 2: Expand dataset coverage and enable full-suite runs nightly on candidate profiles. Phase 3: Integrate outputs into Console and enable per-customer gating flags for Dedicated/Private deployments.
metrics: Key output metrics: perplexity (token/sequence), MMLU accuracy per-task, ROUGE-L/ROUGE-1/ROUGE-2, BLEU for translation, QA EM and F1, aggregated weighted quality score, sample counts, 95% CI, p-value for regression. Operational metrics: runtime eval wall time, per-profile compute cost estimate, failed-eval count.
implementation_notes:
- Score computations should accept raw logits and/or decoded tokens to handle subtle differences introduced by FP8/INT8 quantization.
- Where possible calculate metrics in higher precision (float32) but ensure inputs represent quantized-decoded outputs for parity.
- Use bootstrap resampling for CIs and implement paired tests for A/B comparisons.
- Provide a small shimming layer to re-run existing evaluation prompts with consistent RNG and prompt templates to avoid variability.
- Store provenance: model_commit, profile_id, calibration_artifact_id, dataset_version in each metric output header.
customer_examples: Example scenarios: 1) A customer enables FP8 profile and wants to ensure summarization quality stays within -2 ROUGE-L points; CI uses scorer suite to block rollout. 2) Platform team compares INT8 vs FP8 profiles across MMLU to choose default profile for low-latency tier.
related_docs: Confluence: Quantization QA playbook; Drive: evaluation prompt bank; GitHub: eval runner reference implementation
open_questions: 1) Finalize default weightings for aggregated quality score across different task families. 2) Decide on upstream storage format for CI JSON summaries (S3 vs internal artifact service). 3) Agree whether to include end-user latency cost estimate in metric outputs or compute separately in Console.
communication_plan: Announce in #platform-qa when Phase 1 is merged; present results at the weekly inference triage meeting; create a short how-to doc for PMs and SEs on interpreting CI JSON artifacts.
